title: Born in Bethlehem
summary: Matthew connects Jesus’ birth in Bethlehem with Micah’s promise of a ruler from Bethlehem. This is a New Testament interpretation of the earlier passage.

title: The fall of Babylon
summary: Jeremiah names the Medes in an oracle against Babylon. Daniel narrates the fall of Belshazzar’s kingdom and its reception by Darius the Mede. This sample links the biblical accounts; it does not establish independent historical corroboration.

title: The sign of Immanuel
summary: Matthew applies Isaiah’s Immanuel sign to Jesus’ birth. How that application relates to Isaiah’s immediate setting and the wording of the Hebrew and Greek texts is disputed.
